# Version 4.156.2 (Unreleased)
> **Mask filtered glyph hardening**

## Highlights

Upcoming servicing fixes prevent stale outlines and invalid mask copies when font-scaler output changes between glyph loads.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Mask-filtered glyphs respect reloaded image data** — Rasterizes the reloaded glyph's path and copies overlap only between compatible byte-per-pixel masks. Clipped embossed glyphs preserve full plane strides, preventing stale-path rendering, sub-byte buffer overwrites and corrupted or uncleared mask planes. Managed bindings are unchanged. ([#5742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5742))
